2027 | EMEA | London | FICC &amp; Equities, Sales &amp; Trading | Apprentice Programme

London &amp; South East, United Kingdom

About the role

Our apprentices join the Sales & Trading desks in London and learn how client franchises in fixed income, currencies, commodities and equities are run day to day, rotating between teams over the course of the programme.

Responsibilities

  • Support traders and salespeople with pricing, trade booking and the daily risk process.
  • Build simple tools and analysis that help the desk understand client flows and market moves.
  • Work towards a recognised qualification alongside your role, with study time built into each week.

Qualifications

You are finishing school or college, are curious about markets, communicate clearly, and enjoy working in a fast, team-based environment where accuracy matters and every day is a little different from the last one.
